title: Native reads collect unbounded output and have no deadline
symptom: chough next held 400 MB of native output (774 MiB peak) and waited indefinitely on a stuck command
trigger: A native command that writes very large output or never exits
expected: Capture stops retaining at the parse bound while reading, stderr is bounded and drained, and a deadline reports the state as unknown
actual: Command::output collects everything; there is no deadline
steps: Put a stand-in specsync on PATH that writes 200 MB to each stream, or sleeps
impact: status, next and gates can hang or exhaust memory
source: Review finding F, reproduced 2026-10-31 against main f19823d

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: BUG-0004 fixed parsing beyond the display bound; this is capture during reading
